name: Momose Mitsuki
source:
A Holland Lop beastfolk who is Kaguya's old sister. She is the manager of the newly opened Japanese-style sweets shop, Mochizuki 2. Her homemade dango are simply to die for, but she thinks about new menu items for the sweets shop every day.

She appears to be a bright, friendly and reliable ribbitgirl, but she also has a careless side: making mistakes and forgetting things. She is a little older than the protagonist, but her appearance and clumsiness make her look much younger than her age. She dotes on her timid younger sister Kaguya and can be a little overprotective.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1125252]Getchu[/url]]
